about_the_game:
The “Japan travel spots” Tile Set series features tiles themed around famous sightseeing spots across Japan.
This installment is inspired by Asakusa, one of Japan’s most popular tourist areas.
With retro streetscapes and traditional souvenir shops, you can recreate charming scenes that capture the essence of Japan’s timeless culture and nostalgic atmosphere.

The set includes Tiles A1, A2, A5, B, and C.
It also comes with three variations — Daytime, Evening, and Night — for each of these tiles, allowing you to create rich scene compositions for various settings. These time-based variations make it easy to portray changes in mood and atmosphere throughout the day.

For even greater creative possibilities, this tile set can be combined with the “SERIALGAMES LivingGoodCity Tileset” series to further expand your worldbuilding.

Included Assets

  • Tiles A1, A2, A5, B, C (each with Daytime, Evening, and Night versions, for a total of 15 sheets)

    • Tile A1: Pond

    • Tile A2: Ground, hedges, fences

    • Tile A5: Standalone ground and floor tiles

    • Tile B: Buildings, roofs, shop exteriors, lanterns, bulletin boards, stone lanterns, fences, pillars, etc.

    • Tile C: Shop exteriors, potted plants, benches, rickshaws, omikuji (fortune slip) stands

All tiles are provided in Daytime, Evening, and Night versions.

Sample map (project data) included.

-------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
